correctness.rationale: For each n,q>=2, the S_n word-orbit histograms give a PL fixed triangulation; one omitted nonconstant histogram supplies a Hamming-distance-two pair, and only pairs of omitted different constant histograms otherwise suffice. Thus the dual is precisely q isolated constant vertices. Both the suspension/join proof and equivariant integral Alexander duality establish respectively the homotopy wedge and the signed coaugmentation residual S_q lattice. The parity computation counts transposition-fixed histograms. Eleven finite cases and 46 signed Lefschetz tests agree, with finite experiments not substituted for the proof.
